summary: Test-writing run for issue #5. Dependency viamin/color_matching#110 shipped as viamin/color_matching#113; fetched the real router/controller/schema source from that merge commit to ground fixtures and found real contract deltas (ranked results has zero client support, SheetManifest is missing required capture_profile/printer_profile/created_at, upload response bodies are discarded, measurement upload sends fields absent from the published schema). Documented deltas in docs/color-matching-api-contract-deltas.md and added characterization + failing placeholder Swift tests. Package.swift/generator wiring and model replacement are implementation work, out of scope for this test-writing run and deferred to the run that starts after paid-tests-approved. No Swift toolchain is available in this Linux sandbox, so `swift test` could not be executed here; tests were verified by manual review against existing passing test patterns in the same files.
